verdict.rationale: Jan documents running local HuggingFace models and connecting to cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others). Its docs say users can 'switch freely between local and frontier models' in the same app, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring cloud providers (API key setup, provider settings), independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed local/cloud use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface

citations.quote: Cloud Integration: Connect to GPT models via OpenAI, Claude models via Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax, and others
Local AI Models: Download and run LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss etc.) from HuggingFace
Switch freely between local and frontier models.
Choose from open models or plug in your favorite online models.
